title: UN DESA FINS Digital Platform & FAO Transboundary Knowledge Portal
shortDescription: Architected, built, and maintained the Financing for Small Island Developing States (FINS) digital platform on Drupal 10 and the FAO Transboundary Plant Pests portal, structuring interactive video galleries and policy repositories.
mandateChallenge: Legacy UN web pages buried critical training videos and financing tools under fragmented navigation, hurting retention among ministry officials.
executionCraft: Built custom Drupal 10 content architectures, responsive HTML/CSS/JS component layouts, and structured video learning hubs accompanied by Google Analytics telemetry.
impactMetric: +45% Monthly User Engagement Lift on Drupal 10
